thread:
hiro: Pushed calypso-lite-v0.9 to canary. Quick run of multilingual smoke shows a weird detok/token split in JP furigana when Arabic parentheses are nearby, only on int8. fp16 looks fine.

nora: Can you drop a tiny repro?

hiro: Input:
```
日本語（漢字《ふりがな》）とArabic (مَرْحَبًا)
```
int8 output:
```
日本語（漢字《 ふ り が な 》）とArabic )مَرْحَبًا(
```
Note the spaces inside the ruby brackets and parentheses reversed.

maya: Eval bot stats?

eval-bot: [automated] job=3209876543-A subset=mix-orient BLEU(fp16)=29.8 BLEU(int8)=26.5 sample_mismatch=63/500

kai: Tokenizer inspect likely — but parentheses mirror suggests bidi/detok step too. Can you run `python -m token_inspect` on the ruby span and the whole sentence with both tokenizers?

hiro: Will run token ids + small hex dump. One weird note: int8 decode log shows an inserted 0x20 between multibyte sequences near U+300A/U+300B.

nora: I'll start a quick bisect of runtime detok lib versions used in canary. If it's a libc/unicode upgrade, we might pin. Also add the mixed-orient detok unit test in runtime.

maya: I'll test q4_0 and q5_0 paths to see quant-sensitivity. If other quant modes reproduce, it's probably detok; if only int8, maybe a rounding/byte alignment in decode kernels.

hiro: Thanks — I'll upload small repro tar with seeds and results once token ids are captured.
